comment: NascB catalyzes a radical cascade reaction to form intramolecular and intermolecular carbon-carbon bonds with both regio- and stereo-specificity

reactions.description: NascB catalyzes oxidative dimerization of two molecules of cyclo-(l-tryptophan-l-proline), resulting in simultaneous pyrroloindoline ring formation and C3–C5′ carbon–carbon bond formation to produce naseseazine C.
NascB also converts the synthetic cyclo-(l-tryptophan-l-proline) into naseseazine C and has relaxed substrate specificity.
